decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a cheap plugin on the established map.apps platform, so keeping it costs little, although it has not been visible since 2018 and its value remains unproven.
VueTOC was a small mobile component that has not been visible since its 2018 launch, which suggests its value did not materialize, so abandoning it frees resources for newer options.
The GIS software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, a core commitment rather than a marginal option, so dropping it is unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits steady enterprise and public-sector demand and sits close to the core offer, so the option is still worth holding despite low recent visibility.
The search extension overlaps with the withdrawn hierarchical search plugin and shows no recent evidence of traction, but it costs little to maintain, so it stays for now under watch.
